Reviewed issue: [Responsive shell, common controls, locale and minimal landing](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/78). Dedicated reviewer: **GPT-6.1 Sol, High**, 2026-10-25. Review only; no product/specification/GitHub edits, commits, pushes or status changes.

## Verdict and review boundary

The minimal landing and responsive shell work in the inspected local mock journeys, but **the blanket visual acceptance claim needs qualification**. Two implementation deviations remain: incomplete 48px phone target adaptation and OTP geometry/type that differs from the adopted source. Separately, faithful compact desktop density weakens the main action and frequent navigation, and the language chooser has little visual affordance. Findings: **0 HIGH, 2 MEDIUM, 2 LOW**. This report does not change recorded acceptance or issue state.

Code baseline: `9d286621177200fdb5f61ef963d0b6818ae76774`. Existing dirty documentation, skills and evidence were preserved. `git diff --name-only -- frontend` returned no paths at the end of this review. The source/spec hash inventory is [review-source-hashes.json](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-78/evidence/review-source-hashes.json); local specification files are a dirty-worktree authority, not claimed committed blobs. I did not perform another remote fetch.

Applied Ponytail full, spec-task-review, both design skills and the app-screen guidance with the owner-selected Affect UI Clean/Light and Mabry authority taking precedence over generic style directions. No alternative palette, font, sidebar or marketing expansion is proposed.

## Purpose and user job

## Source comparison

Read the current adoption/token/catalog/workflow and active landing/shared contracts. Read raw BTN Clean CSS289–440 and OTP596–676, and opened matching Light PNGs: BTN `01-initial.png` / `03-loading.png`; OTP `01-initial.png` / `03-invalid-code.png` / `04-verified.png`. These are archived reference images with original source hashes from `_docs/evidence/affect-ui-clean-light/manifest.json`, not fresh Dubbed screenshots. The source PNG canvas/DPR is not a CSS sizing ruler; CSS values determine the comparison.

The rendered controls recognize the selected dark primary, soft destructive, white secondary and modest6px rounding. Opaque focus/error-ink adaptations and Mabry substitution are justified by the contract. The OTP's much larger digits and narrower phone cells are not listed adaptations. The phone sheet is a product derivative; there is no direct source sheet screen to copy. Its broad surface and large rows work; only remaining target/affordance issues below are claimed. No claim is made that every source family (PRO/SEG/PGR/THK/NOT) was independently rerendered in this one issue review.

## QA-78-01 — MEDIUM — Phone target adaptation changes icon height but leaves width32px

**Class:** confirmed implementation defect. **Evidence:** confirmed. **Affected:** AC-02, AC-VIS-01, AC-ICON-01; shared phone shell and menu.

**Reproduce:** complete the visible local-mock registration; set viewport390x844; open Navigation. Inspect/click the top-right close target. Also inspect the brand/home action on the closed public phone landing.

**Expected:** retained48px standard interactive targets, with a48x48 icon-only close hit area. **Actual:** close is **32x48px**, at x342 in the EN phone screenshot; brand/home is **56.8125x40px**. The public support link's actual box is20px high. Rows and menu trigger reach48px, so the adaptation is incomplete rather than universally missing. The report's conclusion is a project-contract mismatch; no generic WCAG conformance failure is inferred merely from these sizes.

**Cause/source:** [App.css:354](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/App.css:354) sets icon width32; [App.css:728](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/App.css:728) changes only height/min-height to48 below768. [sheet.tsx:42](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/components/ui/sheet.tsx:42) consumes icon size. Brand keeps the40px minimum in [App.css:48](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/App.css:48). The normative target is [design-tokens.md:90](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/frontend-flows/design-tokens.md:90).

**Impact:** the sheet's explicit exit still needs precise horizontal targeting; users get inconsistent target sizes while navigating the same phone shell. The40px brand and20px support target also deserve explicit handling under the shared rule.

**Scoped recommendation:** complete the shared phone target adaptation in both dimensions, preserve the small visible glyph, and apply/explicitly resolve the48px rule for brand and public support. Do not enlarge the X itself or alter the desktop reference geometry. **Next validation:** measure both width and height of every visible phone shell/menu target; hit-test the intended padding, use touch and keyboard close, verify Escape/focus return, and recapture EN/RU390/767. Existing tests that check only height would miss this defect.

![Fresh EN phone menu: close target is32px wide](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-78/evidence/shell-en-phone-menu.png)

## QA-78-02 — MEDIUM — Desktop compact sizing weakens the main action and frequent navigation

**Class:** requirement/design flaw, not an implementation mismatch. **Evidence:** measured fact plus visual design judgment. **Affected:** AC-01/AC-02/AC-VIS-01 quality; landing entry and shared frequent navigation.

**Reproduce:** open the landing at1440x900, then compare the registered desktop header and the same landing at390px or just below768px.

**Measured fact:** desktop Start dubbing is **109.89x32px with13px/20px label**. Sign in and each desktop navigation action are **24px high with12px/16px labels**. The body is16/24, heading32/40, and the rendered support link14/20. At767 the CTA becomes approximately700px wide and48px high with16px label, while at768 it returns to roughly118px wide and32px high for RU. Main desktop navigation occupies a narrow band in a64px header with abundant spare horizontal space at1440.

**Expected product quality versus actual:** a casual visitor should immediately identify the start action; repeat signed-in users should scan navigation comfortably. The only main CTA is visually smaller than ordinary body text and even the long blue support link competes with it. Frequent primary navigation reads like peripheral metadata. Large empty space is not itself a defect, and adding content is not the recommendation; the issue is action hierarchy and unnecessary precision within that space.

**Cause/source:** the current owner-selected density is faithfully implemented: [design-tokens.md:88](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/frontend-flows/design-tokens.md:88), [reference catalog geometry](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/frontend-flows/affect-ui-clean-light-reference.md), [App.css:337](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/App.css:337), [AppHeader.tsx:164](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader.tsx:164), and LandingScreen's large button. The contract applies reference chip-sized controls to both a major public entry and all frequent navigation without separately validating those jobs.

**Scoped recommendation:** request a narrow design-contract revision separating dense incidental controls from the landing CTA and global navigation. Compare e.g.40–44px desktop CTA and36–40px navigation hit regions with14–16px labels, while retaining Mabry, palette,6px form and existing minimal content. These are proposed comparison sizes, not an unapproved new implementation contract. **Next validation:** compare actual EN/RU screens at1440/768 and at browser zoom; use quick task finding/clicking checks to choose the size. No preference is asserted to be a proven accessibility violation.

![Fresh desktop landing: small primary action within spacious composition](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-78/evidence/landing-en-desktop.png)

![Fresh desktop shell:24px navigation with12px labels](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-78/evidence/shell-en-desktop.png)

## QA-78-03 — LOW — OTP type and phone cells depart from the explicit adopted recipe

**Class:** confirmed implementation defect in fidelity; not a claim that larger digits are intrinsically less usable. **Evidence:** confirmed CSS and browser metrics. **Affected:** AC-VIS-01 shared OTP appearance consumed by registration/reset.

**Reproduce:** open `/e2e/harness/shared-controls.html` at1440 and390; inspect the populated invalid/verified logical OTP field after fonts load.

**Expected:** [design-tokens.md:108](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/frontend-flows/design-tokens.md:108) specifies40x44 cells,8px gap and Medium15/24 displayed digits; retain40px where they fit. Source `.ui-otpc__box` explicitly uses `min(15px, size*.375)` /24. **Actual:** desktop cells40x44 have **24px/32px** type;390px cells shrink to **36x44 with22px/32px**, even though six40px cells plus five8px gaps total280px and fit the phone harness content width. The normal source invalid/verified appearance is therefore materially different; the code's larger digits may help legibility, but this was not recorded as an approved exception.

**Cause/source:** [OtpInput.css:34](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/auth/OtpInput.css:34) and [OtpInput.css:95](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/auth/OtpInput.css:95) hardcode24/32 and blanket shrink below420. Raw source evidence is `_docs/evidence/affect-ui-clean-light/source/components/otp-input/Clean/otp-input-clean.md.txt:648–674`; the rendered measurement is in supplemental-metrics.json.

**Impact:** the shared control cannot honestly claim exact source typography/geometry fidelity; different perceived scale is visible across auth controls. Code entry still worked in this review, so urgency is low.

**Scoped recommendation:** reconcile the shared mapping with the actual component: restore the adopted recipe or explicitly review/document a larger-digit adaptation. Make any shrinking depend on available container space. **Next validation:** component crop comparison normalized to CSS pixels at1440/390/320, invalid/verified/focus states, six-digit entry/paste and retained logical48px target. Do not copy source tries/resend policy or demonstration account content.

![Fresh shared controls showing large OTP digits](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-78/evidence/controls-en-desktop.png)

## QA-78-04 — LOW — Language switching looks like static two-letter text

**Class:** requirement/design flaw / affordance gap. **Evidence:** confirmed presentation; discoverability impact is a design judgment rather than a measured user study. **Affected:** AC-03 usability and common phone/desktop navigation.

**Reproduce:** inspect the signed-out header or open the signed-in phone menu. The current language appears simply as EN/RU.

**Measured fact:** header select uses12px/16px type, white backing, transparent boundary and `appearance:none`. It keeps12px type in the phone menu where adjacent actions are16px. The phone control has sufficient48px height, but no visible language label or disclosure glyph. Keyboard/assistive naming is present and locale change works; this is not a missing accessible-name defect.

**Expected quality versus actual:** users who need another language should recognize that the current language opens a choice. In the broad phone menu, tiny EN/RU reads as a status fragment between full-sized action rows. The source contains no requirement to remove disclosure from this product locale choice.

**Cause/source:** [App.css:94](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/App.css:94), [App.css:639](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/App.css:639), and [AppHeader.tsx:15](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader.tsx:15). Current language select rules enlarge the box on phones but leave the label treatment unchanged.

**Scoped recommendation:** preserve the native/select semantics and current accessible name; add a visible localized Language label or a small consistent disclosure cue, with phone type aligned to readable menu text. Use the adopted Lucide treatment if adding an icon. **Next validation:** inspect EN/RU default/hover/focus/open selection and ask first-time users to change language without prompting them where to click. No extra navigation or settings feature is needed.

![Fresh RU phone menu: small locale text between full-sized rows](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-78/evidence/shell-ru-phone-menu.png)

## What works and remaining evidence gaps

The page is restrained and coherent with the selected brand. Bilingual headings, body, offer and actions fit; no horizontal overflow was measured. Phone CTA and ordinary menu rows are readable and comfortably sized. The768/767 navigation boundary behaves correctly. The current navigation item is visibly selected. Explicit locale changes update document language and persist. The opaque keyboard focus is clear, forced colors preserves essential text/action outlines, and phone menu Escape returns focus to its trigger. Shared invalid fields explain the problem without clearing text; synthetic pending state blocks repeated activation and synthetic failure retains draft. These are meaningful positive observations, not whole-product acceptance.

Coverage limits: no native200% browser zoom, real mobile browser/virtual keyboard, assistive technology audit, production preference write or live support/email delivery was exercised.720x450 is explicitly a reflow proxy, not zoom proof. The report did not fault-inject landing session/config/locale-write failure, or independently exhaust every default/hover/pressed/disabled/loading/dialog state across all consuming feature screens. The immediate pointer-down supplemental transform sample was matrix1 and is inconclusive about pressed animation, so no motion pass is claimed from that sample. Source reads support the specified button recipe, not runtime timing acceptance. No full suite was run as requested.

Minor unprioritized observation: the sparse landing has extra empty vertical scroll (phone document877 for viewport844;1440x700 document725) from shell/min-height/padding composition. All meaningful content remains visible; this is a polish opportunity, not a blocked task or a separate counted finding. No permanent workaround, additional section or content expansion is recommended.

The reviewed source and fresh local evidence establish these bounded findings. Old implementation pass reports were not reused as fresh screenshots. The review owns only `issue-78/`; all other writers' files are preserved.
